name: Exp_3LineBreak
summary: This EA trades based on the Three Line Break charting indicator, opening buy positions when the trend flips from bearish to bullish and sell positions when it flips from bullish to bearish. It includes configurable money management, stop loss/take profit, and separate controls for opening and closing positions on each side of the market.
summary_zh: 该EA基于三线反转指标进行交易，当趋势从空头转为多头时开多仓，从多头转为空头时开空仓。它包含可配置的资金管理、止损止盈，以及分别控制多空方向开仓和平仓的开关。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是三线反转（Three Line Break）图表法，这是一种过滤市场噪音的趋势跟踪方法。入场条件为：当指标缓冲区2的值从0变为1时产生做多信号，从1变为0时产生做空信号，本质上捕捉趋势反转点。出场条件包括：反向信号触发平仓（如多头信号时平空头仓位）、固定止损（1000点）和固定止盈（2000点）。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于亏损后可用保证金、基于亏损后余额、以及固定手数。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算方式。EA使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线重复交易，SignalBar参数允许选择信号来源K线。此外还包含额外的平仓逻辑：当同方向的开仓和平仓开关都启用且前一信号K线处于反向状态时，会额外触发平仓信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is the Three Line Break charting method, a trend-following approach that filters market noise by requiring significant price reversals to change direction. Entry conditions: when indicator buffer 2 transitions from 0 to 1, a buy signal is generated; when it transitions from 1 to 0, a sell signal is generated, essentially capturing trend reversal points. Exit conditions include: reverse signal triggers position closure (e.g., close sell on buy signal), fixed stop loss of 1000 points, and fixed take profit of 2000 points. Position sizing supports five modes: based on free margin, based on balance, based on free margin after losses, based on balance after losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk proportion and MMMode for the calculation method. The EA uses a new bar detection mechanism (CIsNewBar class) to prevent repeated trading on the same bar, and the SignalBar parameter allows selecting which bar to read signals from. An additional closure logic exists: when both the open and close switches for the same direction are enabled and the previous signal bar is in the opposing state, an extra close signal is triggered.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or fixed lot size

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：可用保证金/余额/亏损后保证金/亏损后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/post-loss margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: InpInd_Timeframe
parameters.description: 三线反转指标的时间周期

parameters.name: Lines_Break
parameters.description_en: Number of lines for Three Line Break

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取交易信号的K线索引

pros: 三线反转指标能有效过滤市场噪音，减少假信号
支持多种资金管理模式，灵活度高
多空方向的开仓和平仓可独立控制，策略配置灵活
使用新K线检测机制避免重复开仓，逻辑严谨
止损止盈参数可配置，具备基础风险控制
pros_en: The Three Line Break indicator effectively filters market noise and reduces false signals
Supports multiple money management modes for high flexibility
Buy and sell open/close controls are independent, allowing granular strategy configuration
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate entries, showing solid logic design
Configurable stop loss and take profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点默认值偏大，可能不适合所有品种和波动率环境
没有包含点差过滤，在交易成本较高的品种上可能亏损
依赖自定义指标文件（3LineBreak），部署时需确保指标可用
缺少对持仓状态的检查，可能重复开仓或对冲
策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁的假反转信号导致连续亏损
cons_en: Default SL of 1000 and TP of 2000 points are large and may not suit all instruments or volatility environments
No spread filter included, which could lead to losses on high-spread instruments
Depends on a custom indicator file (3LineBreak), requiring it to be available at deployment
Lacks position state checking, potentially leading to duplicate openings or hedging
The strategy is prone to frequent false reversal signals in ranging markets, causing consecutive losses
improvements: 增加点差和波动率过滤，避免在高成本环境下交易
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免重复开仓或意外对冲
增加追踪止损或动态止损止盈，根据ATR自动调整
improvements_en: Add spread and volatility filters to avoid trading in high-cost environments
Add position checking logic to prevent duplicate openings or unintended hedging
Add trailing stop or dynamic SL/TP that adjusts based on ATR

risk_points: 缺少持仓状态检查，可能在已有同向仓位时重复开仓
三线反转在震荡市中会产生频繁假信号，导致连续亏损
依赖外部自定义指标，若指标缺失则EA无法正常运行
risk_points_en: Lacks position state checking, may open duplicate positions in the same direction
Three Line Break generates frequent false signals in ranging markets, causing consecutive losses
Depends on an external custom indicator; if missing, the EA cannot function properly
